DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報の変更ですね。どなた名義の口座についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change registered information. Whose account is this about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と配偶者の口座です。同じ家に引っ越したので、二人とも一度に住所を変えられると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居の本人と配偶者の二口座の住所を一度に変えられると思って来たと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My account and my spouse's. We moved to the same home, so I came thinking I could change both addresses at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came thinking both your and your cohabiting spouse's account addresses could be changed together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の名義ごとに、ご希望と必要な確認を整理しましょう。今日は、お二人でお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us organize requests and necessary checks separately for each account holder. Are both of you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は私一人です。配偶者の通帳も預かりましたが、それだけで全部できるとは決められないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来訪は自分だけで配偶者の通帳はあるが、それで全手続き可と判断できないと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only I am here. I brought my spouse's passbook too, but that alone does not mean everything can be done, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm only you came and have your spouse's passbook, but cannot conclude all procedures are possible with that. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの物だけで判断せず、担当に確認します。まず、ご本人の変更したい項目を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with staff rather than decide from what you brought alone. First tell us the items you yourself want changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の住所と電話番号です。新しい住所の書類はありますが、前の電話番号は今は使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の住所と電話番号を変えたく、新住所の書類はあるが旧電話は使っていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My address and phone number. I have documents for the new address, but no longer use the old phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want your address and phone number changed, have new-address documents and no longer use the old phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所と電話番号の変更希望ですね。登録状況と必要な確認は担当が伺います。通知の送付先についても、気になることがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Address and phone changes, then. Staff will ask about registration status and necessary checks. Any concerns about where notices are sent too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人分の通知が全部同じ扱いになると思っていました。私の口座の通知がどこへ送られるかを先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人の通知を同じ扱いと思っていたが、まず自分の口座の送付先を確かめたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought all notices for both of us would be handled the same. First I want to check where my account's notices will be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you thought both people's notices were handled the same, but want to check your own account's delivery address first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の通知先の質問としてお伝えします。配偶者の方の変更をどう相談するかは、別に確認する形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on as your notice-address question. May we separately confirm how to discuss changes for your spouse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私の住所、電話、通知先を先に相談します。配偶者の分は、何を確認してからお願いできるかを別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の住所・電話・通知先を先に相談し、配偶者分に必要な確認は別に尋ねると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will discuss my address, phone and notice destination first. Separately, I will ask what must be checked before requesting my spouse's changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to discuss your address, phone and notice destination first, and ask separately about checks needed for your spouse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序で担当へ引き継ぎます。書類と二つの口座の情報が混ざらないよう、お手元で分けてご用意ください。それでは、担当とのご相談へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hand over in that order. Keep documents and the two accounts' information separate and ready with you. Please proceed to consult the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子の表示をご覧になっていますね。確認したい箇所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reading the sweets label. Is there anything you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乳にアレルギーのある家族に買いたいです。表に「乳不使用」とあるので、これなら大丈夫かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乳アレルギーの家族用で、表の乳不使用表示から大丈夫と思ったと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy for family with a milk allergy. The front says no milk used, so I thought this might be all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss buying for milk-allergic family and thinking the front's no-milk-used label meant it was all right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表面だけでなく、裏の原材料欄と注意書きも見ましょう。こちらには、乳成分を含む製品と共通の設備という記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Look at the ingredients and cautions on the back as well as the front. This says equipment is shared with products containing milk ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その注意書きを見落としていました。不使用の文字だけで、家族が食べられると決めない方がよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共通設備の注意を見落とし、不使用の文字だけで食べられると決めないと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed that caution. I should not decide my family can eat it just from the words no milk used, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm you missed the shared-equipment caution and will not decide edibility from no-milk-used wording alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは個別に食べられるかを判断できません。メーカーへの問合せには、商品の名前や注意書きの全文があると内容を伝えやすいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot judge whether a particular person can eat it. When contacting the manufacturer, the product name and full caution text should help explain your question.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品名と裏の注意書きを控えます。メーカーにこの記載を確認し、家族にも共有してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品名と注意書きを控えてメーカーへ記載を尋ね、家族と共有してから選ぶと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will note the product name and back caution. I want to check this wording with the manufacturer and share it with family before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will note the name and caution, ask the manufacturer about the wording and share with family before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのようになさってください。ほかに表示で分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Is any other labeling unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保存欄の「開封後は冷蔵」は、開ける前とは別の条件ですか。未開封の欄と読み分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封後は冷蔵という表示と未開封の条件を別に読みたいと尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Does refrigerate after opening mean a condition different from before opening? I want to read it separately from the unopened section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to read refrigerate-after-opening separately from unopened storage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封前と開封後は、こちらの別々の欄で確認してください。保存の表示が読めても、アレルギーについての確認が済んだことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check before and after opening in these separate sections. Being able to read storage instructions does not mean the allergy check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの保存欄も控えます。家族に合うかはまだ分からないので、今日はこの商品を買わず、確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存二欄も控えるが家族への適合は不明なので、今日は買わず確認後に決めると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note both storage sections too. I still do not know whether it suits my family, so will not buy this today and will decide after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note both storage sections but will not buy today because suitability for family is unknown, and will decide after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご不明な表示を確認してからお選びください。商品はこちらでお預かりします。それでは、引き続きご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Choose after confirming unclear labeling. I will take the product here. Please continue looking around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内を歩くご予定でしょうか。案内図で見たい所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Planning a walk in the park? Anything you want to see on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 奥の花壇まで散歩したいです。途中にベンチの印があるので、そこで必ず座って休めると思って予定を立てていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 奥の花壇へ歩き途中のベンチで必ず座れると思っていたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to walk to the flower beds further inside. There is a bench symbol on the way, so I planned thinking I could definitely sit and rest there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wanted to walk to the far flower beds and thought you could definitely sit on a bench on the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印はベンチの場所を示しますが、空いているかは別です。途中で座って休むことを、予定に入れていらっしゃるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The symbol shows a bench location, but availability is separate. You have included a seated rest on the way in your plan, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。長く続けて歩かず、休みを入れたいです。あちらに見える近くのベンチも、今は人が座っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連続して長く歩かず休みたいと述べ、近くに見える席も利用中だと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not want to walk continuously for a long time and want breaks. The nearby bench we can see is occupied now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want breaks rather than a long continuous walk, and confirm the nearby visible seats are in use too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 近くの席もご利用中ですね。奥まで行くことを先に決めず、今日はどこまで歩くか考え直すこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those nearby seats are in use too. You can reconsider how far to walk today rather than deciding to go all the way inside first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は奥の花壇を目標にするのをやめます。入口の近くにいる間に、座って休める場所を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 奥の花壇を目標にせず、入口近くで座って休める状況を先に確かめると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will stop aiming for the far flower beds for now. While still near the entrance, I want to check where I can sit and rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to aim for the far flower beds and first check whether you can sit and rest near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩できる状況を先に見るということですね。席が空く時刻や、必ず座れる場所まではお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You will check the rest situation first. We cannot promise when seats will free up or a place where you can definitely sit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 席が空くのを当てにして歩き始めないようにします。ここから入口へ戻る表示は、どれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席が空くことに頼って歩き始めず、現在地から入口へ戻る表示を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will avoid starting a walk relying on seats becoming available. Which sign shows the way back to the entrance from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not start walking relying on seats freeing up, and ask which sign leads from here back to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図では、こちらの入口の印です。今いる案内所からの表示も、現地で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: On the map, this is the entrance symbol. Check the signs from the information center where you are now on site too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の印を確認しました。まず休める状況を見て、難しければ今日は奥へ進まず帰ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口の印を確認し、休憩できる状況がなければ奥へ進まず帰ると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the entrance symbol. First I will look at whether I can rest, and if that is difficult I will go home today without heading further inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you checked the entrance symbol and will return without going further inside if there is no opportunity to rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 歩く範囲を決め直す方針になりましたね。休憩の予定も含め、ご自分に合う範囲でお過ごしください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have decided to reconsider your walking range. Including rest plans, spend time within a range that suits you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物ですね。別の列車へ乗り換えますか、それとも改札を出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is large luggage. Are you transferring trains or leaving through the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 改札を出たいです。荷物を持って階段を下りるのは難しいので、段差を避ける道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換ではなく改札外へ出たいと伝え、重い荷物のため階段を下りずに済む道を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to leave the gates. It is difficult to take the luggage down stairs, so please tell me a route avoiding steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave the station rather than transfer, and ask for a route avoiding stair descent with heavy luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、出口へ向かうエレベーターの案内を見ましょう。今ご覧になっていた矢印は、乗換通路への表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let us look at elevator directions to the exit. The arrow you were looking at points to a transfer passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 矢印の先にある階段を下りるところでした。改札へ行くエレベーターは、その矢印とは別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換矢印の先の階段へ進みかけたと説明し、出口のエレベーター経路は別だと確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was about to go down the stairs beyond that arrow. The elevator route to the gates is separate from that arrow, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you almost followed the transfer arrow to stairs, and confirm the exit elevator route is different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、こちらの案内図で経路を分けて確認できます。ただ、今はそのエレベーターの点検表示が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, you can check the separate routes on this map. But that elevator currently has an inspection sign displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使えると思って進む前に聞けてよかったです。自分で荷物を階段から下ろすのは避けたいので、ほかの経路か案内の手助けを頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 点検中の設備へ進まず、自力で荷物を階段から下ろす代わりの経路か案内支援を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Good thing I asked before heading there assuming it worked. I want to avoid taking the luggage down stairs myself, so could I request another route or guidance assistance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Rather than head to equipment under inspection or carry luggage downstairs yourself, ask for an alternative route or guidance assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の経路が利用できるか、案内担当へ確認します。手配が決まるまで、この窓口横でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with guidance staff whether another route is usable. Could you wait beside this counter until arrangements are settled?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。迎えの人は改札の外にいるので、点検のため移動の案内を待っていると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口横で待つと答え、迎えの人へ点検のため案内待ちであると連絡すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. The person meeting me is outside the gates, so I will tell them I am awaiting directions because of inspection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to wait beside the counter and say you will tell your pickup person you are awaiting guidance due to inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。外の方と合流する改札も、どちら側か確認しておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that. It is also good to check which side the gate where you will meet them outside is on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ち合わせのメッセージを見て、改札名も確かめます。案内が決まったら動けるよう、荷物を持ってこの横で待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迎えとのメッセージで改札名を確かめ、案内が決まるまで荷物と一緒に窓口横で待つと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the meeting message and gate name too. I will wait beside here with my luggage so I can move when guidance is arranged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the gate name in pickup messages and wait with luggage beside the counter until guidance is arranged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内担当に、階段を避けたいことと待機場所を伝えました。ここでお声がけしますので、通路を空けてお待ちください。こちらでのご相談は承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I told guidance staff you want to avoid stairs and where you are waiting. We will call you here, so keep the passage clear while waiting. We have received your request here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。お引っ越しの状況から伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about moving in. May I first ask about your move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の市から来ました。契約書の日付と実際に住み始めた日が違うので、どちらを伝えるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別の市から転居し、契約開始日と生活開始日が違うためどちらを伝えるか迷っていると説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came from another city. The contract date differs from when I actually started living there, so I am unsure which to report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain moving from another city and being unsure which to report because contract start and actual residence dates differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの日を区別してお話しください。契約が始まった日と、実際に生活を始めた日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell us the two days distinctly. When did the contract begin and when did you actually start living there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約は今月一日からですが、荷物を運んで住み始めたのは五日です。一日から住んでいたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約は今月一日、実際に荷物を運び住み始めたのは五日と区別して伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract starts on the first of this month, but I carried my belongings and began living there on the fifth. I was not living there from the first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the contract starting on this month's first from moving belongings and actually starting residence on the fifth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを担当へ伝えましょう。書く日付は確認してからにしてください。以前のお住まいの窓口で受け取った物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell staff that difference. Confirm before writing the date. Do you have anything received from the counter at your previous residence?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒を受け取りました。中に二枚あるので、どちらか一枚だけ出せばよいと思っていましたが、両方見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前の窓口から受け取った封筒に書類が二枚あり、一枚と決めず両方を確認してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I received this envelope. There are two sheets inside, so I thought only one needed submitting, but could you check both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the previous counter's envelope contains two documents and ask to check both rather than decide only one is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒ごと担当にお見せください。必要な書類かは内容を確認して判断します。本人確認のためにお持ちの物もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the whole envelope to staff. They will judge necessary documents after checking contents. Have you also brought identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードを持っています。契約書は控えの写真だけなので、原本が必要かも一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードはあるが契約書は写真だけなので、原本が必要かも尋ねたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My residence card. I only have a photo copy of the contract, so want to ask whether the original is needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a residence card but only a contract photo, and also want to ask whether the original is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で足りると決めず、その質問を添えます。確認が必要なのは、申告する日付、封筒の二枚、契約書の原本ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will add that question without deciding a photo suffices. The checks are the reported date, the envelope's two sheets and the original contract, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三点でお願いします。日付欄にはまだ書かず、一日が契約開始、五日が生活開始とメモして担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付・二枚の書類・契約書原本の三点を確認し、日付欄を埋めず一日と五日の違いをメモして説明すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those three, please. I will not fill the date field yet, but note the first as contract start and the fifth as living start and explain to staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the three checks of date, two documents and original contract, and say you will leave the date blank and explain notes distinguishing the first and fifth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談内容をまとめた紙はこちらです。封筒とカードをお手元に、担当の席へお進みください。日付の違いも引き継ぎました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the paper summarizing your questions. Keep your envelope and card with you and go to the staff's desk. I have passed on the date difference too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更について、現在の予約日時とお困りの事情を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: For changing your booking, tell us the current day and time and your difficulty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今週の木曜午前に予約がありますが、勤務が入りました。来週火曜の午後へ移せるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今週木曜午前の予約が勤務と重なり、来週火曜午後へ変更を相談したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a booking this Thursday morning, but was assigned work. I want to discuss moving it to next Tuesday afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say this Thursday morning's appointment overlaps work and you want to discuss next Tuesday afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を拝見します。その時間に変更できるかは担当へ照会します。ほかにも来られる時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the slip. I will ask staff whether that time is possible. Are there other times you can come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 火曜午後が無理なら水曜午前なら来られます。同じ先生に診てもらいたいという希望も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代わりに水曜午前も来られることと、同じ医師を希望することを伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: If Tuesday afternoon is impossible, I can come Wednesday morning. Please also pass on my wish to see the same doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say Wednesday morning is another available time and request the same doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの候補と担当医の希望を記録しました。受診を後ろに動かす相談にあたり、症状などに変化があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I recorded two candidates and your doctor preference. When discussing postponement, tell us any changes in symptoms or similar matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今のところ変化はありません。ただ、日を延ばしてよいかは自分ではわからないので、診療担当にも確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現状の変化はないが受診を延期してよいか自分で判断できず、診療担当へ確認してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No changes so far. But I cannot judge whether delaying the visit is all right, so please also check with clinical staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report no current change but ask clinical staff to check whether postponing is acceptable because you cannot judge yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も診療担当へ伝えます。現時点では日時の変更は確定していません。確認の返答はどのように受けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them that too. No date or time change is confirmed yet. How can you receive the reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の午後は電話に出られます。まだ元の木曜の予約が消えたと思わず、返事を待つということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日午後は電話に出られると伝え、元の木曜予約が取り消されたと思わず返答を待つと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can answer the phone this afternoon. I should wait for the reply without thinking the original Thursday booking has already disappeared, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can answer this afternoon and confirm you will await reply without assuming the original Thursday appointment is canceled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。返答の際に、変更の可否と確定した日時、元の予約の扱いを一緒に確認してください。連絡先はこの欄で見直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When they reply, check whether change is possible, the confirmed time and date, and treatment of the old booking together. Review contact details in this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先は合っています。来週火曜午後、難しければ水曜午前は希望として控え、返答で確定日時と木曜の扱いを聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を確認し、二候補は希望に留め、返答時に確定日時と元予約の扱いを聞き直すと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The contact details are correct. I will keep next Tuesday afternoon or alternatively Wednesday morning as preferences, and ask again in the reply for the confirmed time and Thursday's treatment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm contact details, keep the two candidates as requests and ask again about confirmed time and the original booking when they reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望と確認事項を担当へ渡しました。今日は変更済みではなく、返答待ちとしてお控えください。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have passed your requests and checks to staff. Record today as awaiting reply, not already changed. Thank you for contacting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご相談ですね。今どのようなことがわかっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: About your bicycle, what do you know so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝、停めた場所に自転車がありませんでした。近くに工事の紙がありましたが、移されたのか盗まれたのかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車がなく工事案内もあるが、移動か盗難か不明だと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This morning my bicycle was absent from where I parked. A construction notice was nearby, but I do not know whether it was moved or stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the bicycle is gone and there is a construction notice, but movement versus theft is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に停めた時刻と場所、それから工事の紙に何とあったかを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Separately tell us when and where you last parked and what the construction paper said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜七時ごろ、駐輪場の屋根がない側に停めました。紙は写真に撮りましたが、文字をまだ読み切れておらず、管理者にも聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夜七時ごろ屋根のない側に停めたこと、工事紙は撮影したが未読部分があり管理者も未照会と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around seven last night, on the roofless side of the bicycle parking area. I photographed the paper, but have not finished reading it and have not asked management.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you parked on the uncovered side around seven last night, photographed the construction notice but have unread parts and have not asked management. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真を見ながら、管理者への確認先も整理しましょう。自転車の特徴や番号がわかる資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the photo and organize where to contact management too. Do you have materials showing bicycle features or numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い車体で前かごに黄色いひもがあります。写真はありますが、防犯登録の控えは家族が保管していて、今は番号が言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白い車体と前かごの黄色いひもを説明し、写真はあるが登録控えは家族にあり番号は不明と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A white frame with yellow cord on the front basket. I have a photo, but family keep the anti-theft registration copy, so I cannot give the number now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe white frame and yellow front-basket cord, and say you have a photo but family hold the registration copy and the number is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号は推測せず、後で控えを確認してください。停めたときに鍵をかけたかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not guess the number; check the copy later. Do you remember locking it when you parked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普段はかけますが、昨夜かけたかは自信がありません。「いつもかける」と「昨夜もかけた」は分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 普段施錠することと昨夜施錠した確証は別で、昨夜については自信がないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I usually lock it, but am not confident I did last night. I will distinguish usually locking from having locked it last night too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish habitual locking from proof of locking last night and say you are uncertain about last night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かなことと不明なことを分けて記録します。管理者から回答を受けた後も、相談の続きに使えるよう状況を控えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record certainty separately from unknowns. Keep notes of the situation for continued consultation after management answers too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停めた場所と工事の写真、鍵は不明という点をメモします。家族に登録番号を確認し、管理者に聞けた内容も添えてまた相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所・工事写真・施錠不明を記録し、家族に番号を確認して管理者の回答も添え再相談すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the parking place, construction photo and unknown lock status. I will check the registration number with family and consult again with what management tells me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record location, construction photo and unknown locking, check the number with family and return with management's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伺った内容を記録しました。追加でわかったことは、この相談の続きとしてお知らせください。移動されたのか盗まれたのかはまだ断定せず、確認を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I recorded what you said. Tell us additional findings as a continuation of this consultation. Without deciding yet whether moved or stolen, let us continue checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類をお送りになるのですね。提出先から、送り方の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sending documents, then. Does the recipient specify a sending method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「記録の残る方法で」とだけ書いてあります。追跡番号があれば、中に何を入れたかもわかるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内が「記録の残る方法」とだけ指定し、追跡番号で封入内容までわかるのか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It only says use a method leaving a record. If there is a tracking number, can it also show what I put inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the guidance only specifies a method leaving a record, and ask whether tracking numbers show enclosed contents too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡で確認する配達状況と、封筒の中の書類の控えは別の話です。提出先がどの記録を求めているか、この文だけではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Delivery status checked by tracking and copies of enclosed documents are separate. This sentence alone does not tell us which record the recipient wants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は内容まで残ると思っていました。発送した記録なのか、配達された状況の記録なのかも、提出先に聞き分けたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内容の記録と混同していたと認め、差出しの記録か配達状況の記録かを提出先に聞き分ける必要を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it recorded contents too. I should ask the recipient distinctly whether they mean a dispatch record or a delivery-status record, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit confusing this with contents records and confirm the need to ask the recipient whether dispatch or delivery-status records are meant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。必要な記録がわかってから、それに対応できる送り方を比較しましょう。宛先や期限の指定も同じ案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Once you know the needed record, compare methods that provide it. Does that same guide give the address and deadline too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先はありますが、期限は「必着」です。窓口に出した日でよいと思っていたので、間に合うかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内は必着なのに差出日でよいと思っていたと伝え、到着に間に合うかも確認したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is an address, but the deadline says must arrive by. I thought the day I handed it to the counter was enough, so also want to check whether arrival will be in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the guidance says must arrive by but you thought dispatch date sufficed, and want to check timely arrival too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着の期限と差出日を混同しないようにしましょう。配達見込みは宛先や方法で確認が必要で、ここで必ず間に合うとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not confuse arrival deadline and dispatch date. Delivery estimates need checking by address and method; we cannot promise here it will definitely be in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出先に、必要な記録と到着期限の二点を聞きます。自分の控えもまだ作っていないので、封はせず持ち帰って準備し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先へ記録と到着期限を確認し、自分の控えも未準備なので封をせず持ち帰ると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the recipient the two points of required record and arrival deadline. I have not made my own copy either, so will take it home unsealed and prepare again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check record and arrival deadline with the recipient and take it home unsealed because your own copy is not ready either. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた条件を持って再度ご相談ください。宛先は、部署名まで書き写せているかも見直しておくと整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring the confirmed conditions for another consultation. Reviewing whether the address includes the department name will help too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部署名と自分の住所も見直します。送り方を先に決めず、内容の控えと提出先の回答をそろえてから、料金と配達見込みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部署名と差出人住所を見直し、内容控えと提出先回答をそろえてから料金と配達見込みを相談すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will review the department and my own address. Without choosing the method first, I will prepare content copies and the recipient's reply, then ask about costs and estimated delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will review department and sender address and consult costs and delivery estimates after preparing content copies and the recipient's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日は差出しをせず封筒をお返しします。必要な記録について回答が得られたら、その案内もお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will return your envelope without dispatching today. Once you have a reply about needed records, bring that guidance too. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のお申し込み前のご相談ですね。ご利用の目的から教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is advice before applying to open an account. Could you first tell us the purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与を受け取るためです。会社の用紙はカタカナで、手元の身分証はローマ字なので、名前の書き方が合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取目的で口座を作りたいが、会社のカタカナ表記と身分証のローマ字が合うか心配だと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Receiving salary. The company form is in katakana and my ID is in Roman letters, so I worry whether the name formats match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a salary account but worry about matching company katakana and ID Roman-letter names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で順番や表記を変える前に、担当と照合しましょう。会社の用紙と本人確認に使う書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before changing order or spelling yourself, compare with staff. Do you have the company form and documents used for identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。会社の欄には姓が後になっていますが、私が反対に書き直してよいのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両方の書類を提示し、会社の氏名欄は姓が後なので自分で順番を直してよいか迷うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both. The company field has my family name last, but I do not know whether I may reverse it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show both documents and explain the company name field has surname last, making you unsure whether to change its order yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは書き直さず、元の用紙をそのまま担当へ見せてください。勤務先の案内も、口座の申込みとは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not rewrite it here; show the original form unchanged to staff. We will check workplace instructions separately from the account application too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社がどういう表記を求めているか、担当に見てもらってから会社へも聞きます。この書類がそろっていれば今日開設できる、とは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当と会社双方へ表記を確認すると述べ、持参書類だけで当日開設が保証されないと確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: After staff look at it, I will also ask work what name format they require. Having these documents alone does not guarantee opening today, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check name format with staff and work, and confirm brought documents alone do not guarantee same-day opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの確認や審査もあるため、開設可否や完了日はこの場で確約できません。会社への口座情報の提出期限についてもご心配がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Other checks and screening are needed too, so we cannot guarantee opening approval or completion date here. Are you concerned about the company deadline for account information too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日までに会社へ口座情報を出すよう言われています。今日できると約束せず、確認中と会社に伝えるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社への口座情報提出期限が明日と伝え、当日開設を約束せず確認中と会社に知らせる意向を述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am told to submit account information to work by tomorrow. I will not promise it can be done today, but tell work it is being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say work's account-information deadline is tomorrow and you will say checking is underway without promising same-day opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限が明日という事情を担当へ伝えます。必要書類や次の相談方法も、名前の照合と一緒に説明を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell staff about tomorrow's deadline. Get explanations of needed documents and how to proceed with the next consultation alongside name comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 氏名の表記、追加書類、次の申込方法を聞きます。会社の用紙にはまだ口座番号を書かず、開設できたと勘違いされないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名・追加書類・次の申込方法を聞くと整理し、未開設なので会社用紙に口座番号を書かず誤解を避けると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about name format, additional documents and next application steps. I will not write an account number on the company form yet, to avoid being mistaken for already having opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize questions about name, additional documents and next application method, and say you will not enter an account number on the work form while unopened to avoid misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙と書類はご自身でお持ちになり、こちらの担当席へどうぞ。表記の懸念と明日の期限を引き継ぎました。ご相談を承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the form and documents yourself and go to this staff desk. I passed on name-format concerns and tomorrow's deadline. Your consultation request is received.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの棚の値札について、何かご不明な点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything unclear about this shelf's price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このごみ袋を一袋だけ欲しいのですが、大きく書かれた価格は一袋の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ごみ袋を一袋だけ欲しく、大きく書かれた価格が一袋分なのか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want only one pack of these garbage bags. Is the large printed price for one pack?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the large price is for one pack, as you want only one pack of garbage bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きい文字の上に「対象品二点で」とあります。こちらは二点分の表示です。一袋の表示も、この下にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Above the large print it says for two eligible items. This display is for two. One-pack pricing is below too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二点分を一袋の値段だと思っていました。一袋には何枚入るかも見て、買いすぎないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二点分を一袋の価格と誤読したと認め、一袋の枚数も確かめ買いすぎを避けたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mistook two-item pricing for one pack. I want to check how many bags are in a pack too, to avoid buying too many.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit misreading two-item pricing as one-pack pricing, and say you want to check bags per pack to avoid overbuying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枚数は袋の表にあります。同じ柄でも容量が違う物が隣にありますので、値札の商品名と容量も合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The count is on the front. The same design in a different capacity is beside it, so match the price tag's product name and capacity too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で使うのはこちらの小さい容量です。隣の大きい袋を一緒に選んでも二点の対象になるのか、札だけでは読み取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要なのは小容量だが隣の大容量との組合せも割引対象か札では不明だと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I use this smaller capacity at home. I cannot tell from the tag whether combining it with the large pack beside it also qualifies for two-item pricing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need small capacity but cannot tell from the tag whether combining it with neighboring large capacity qualifies for the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象の商品番号を確認します。すべての容量が組み合わせられるとは限りません。まとめて買うことがご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check eligible product numbers. Not all capacities necessarily combine. Do you want to buy in bulk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、安く見えたので迷っただけです。収納が狭いので、小さい容量を一袋買う場合の価格だけ確かめたいです。
